reviews.text:
We highly recommend this groomer for their friendliness and warm welcome.
It was a pleasure to be so well received, especially since we didn't have an appointment. We needed to have our Shih Tzu's nails trimmed, and it was done very well. They even gave me tips on how to do it myself if needed.
A very nice, well-equipped, and pleasant grooming salon.
A successful experience, but above all, a very warm welcome.
Thank you so much, Tya is magnificent! The work done on my Pomeranian is remarkable. We will definitely be back. See you very soon.
Hangs up on me. Very rude.

I came to this salon on Wednesday to have my Bichon Frise groomed for the first time.

The service was even faster than expected, he left with a really great grooming job, and very relaxed. The staff are extremely kind and friendly!

Plus, being able to book appointments online is super convenient :) And the price isn't high at all either!
I recommend it 1000% because I find it difficult to find good grooming salons :)
Thank you, my Spitz came out perfectly groomed, see you soon!

So, leaving a review that's neither positive nor negative, and then receiving a phone call during which I'm aggressively reprimanded, is unacceptable.

I initially gave 3 stars. Following this exchange, I'm unfortunately reducing my rating to 1 star.

Being harshly criticized over the phone because I stated I paid €110 when the correct amount was €103 seems quite disproportionate. I'm therefore happy to correct this €7 error, which doesn't change the substance of my review.

And since I'm also being reprimanded because I'm a business owner, I'd like to remind everyone of what I consider to be the basics of customer relations and business when someone isn't fully satisfied:

1) Apologize.

2) Perhaps offer a discount for a future visit.

3) And above all, never insult your customer.

So, to reiterate my initial opinion:

I'm not giving a good or bad rating, because we can't say our dog was mistreated… but we also can't say the service was particularly satisfactory.

Out of curiosity, I asked ChatGPT and Gemini the exact same question:

"What is the price of grooming for a Labrador without a bath or nail trim?"

The two answers were very similar:

Gemini:

Dry brushing/dematting: €25 to €40.

ChatGPT:

Full brushing, detangling, and undercoat removal: €25 to €45.
Ear cleaning (if requested): +€5 to €10.
Finishing touches (eyes, paw pads, etc.): included or +€5.

For a service without a bath or nail trim: €25 to €35 in a standard salon, €35 to €45 in a high-end salon with a more thorough service.

I am therefore surprised to have paid €103 for a service without a bath, with a lingering odor and untrimmed nails.

This is simply my personal experience. However, the way he was received disappointed me far more than the service itself.

I am not expecting a response. (I insist.)

Everyone will form their own opinion.

I brought my four-year-old Maine Coon cat, Timothée, in because he had huge mats absolutely everywhere. He's not used to going to the groomer; it was only his second time. They were amazing—I don't know a stronger word, but they were truly amazing. Timothée stayed calm and he's spotless. I highly recommend them, and the people are lovely too. Thank you so much!
Incredible work and incredible welcome for my Samoyed!! Best salon I've ever seen
Excellent result, very professional language, pleasant staff, and very good advice. Nougat thanks you, and so do we. I highly recommend them.
First time for my spitz chanel, very warm welcome, attentive, gentle and lady passionate about animals.

First time at Tout beau tout chien for our Samoyed, Mizzo! I have to say that not only was the welcome super warm, but the work was excellent! In 2.5 hours, the little guy was all squeaky clean, looking brand new, haha!
Thank you to the team for their time and dedication, we'll be back :-)

Top: the welcome, the friendliness, the availability, the result.
Everest plans to return every month for his relaxation time 🤩🩷 …
After booking on the website for 5:30 PM, the person on site told me it wasn't possible, even though there was plenty of time. I don't understand; there were no other customers there.
Wow, excellent service!! A big thank you to Adele :)

I took my dog ​​Una to the groomer for the very first time. I was very stressed because I wanted a very natural cut and not at all a "shower dog" look. I was seen by Adèle, who was fantastic! She listened very well to what I wanted, was reassuring, flexible, and very kind to Una! I just picked her up, and the result is amazing! I highly recommend her and I'll be back.
You will find the staff welcoming from the moment you arrive.
